title: Spicy Korean Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Korean-inspired stew made with napa cabbage, korean chili flakes, and a hint of sweetness from the cabbage.

ingredients.name: Korean Chili Flakes (gochugaru)
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for desired level of spiciness

ingredients.name: Fluffy Quenched Sauce
ingredients.notes: See notes for making this sauce

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: Optional, but recommended for added depth of flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shredded napa cabbage and cook for 3-4 minutes, until slightly softened.
Add the Korean chili flakes, stew, fluffy quenched sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes, until the cabbage is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
